disambiguation: Not an AI chat client; it imports and syncs chats from external AI services into Markdown notes.
extras: Unofficial and read-only; the Browser link extension is not distributed through extension stores, and the privacy filter can miss secrets. Mobile sync requires a computer with Obsidian open.
motivation: To offer a low-friction, easy way into Karpathy-style LLM Wikis, second brains and project brains.
problem: AI chat history is scattered across provider web apps and local session files, so it cannot be searched or linked with notes in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Its AI group runs AI ChatBridge's sync commands with one click
